sentences.text:
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:180413
Court No. - 72
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 1209 of 2023

Applicant :- Indrasen Seth
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Satya Prakash Singh

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Kundan Kumar,Ved Prakash,Vineet Singh Parmar
Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1.
List has been revised.
Learned counsel for the informant is not present.

2. Heard Sri Satya Prakash Singh, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Varun Pratap Singh,
learned A.G.A. for the State as well as perused the record.
3.

The present anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in Case Crime No.448 of 2022, registered under Sections 354, 504, 506, 376 I.P.C. at Police Station- Maharajganj,
District- Azamgarh with a prayer to enlarge him on anticipatory bail.

4. As per the allegations in the FIR, the applicant is stated to have barged into the shop of the informant on 25.11.2022 at about 08:00 p.m. and is stated to have outraged her modesty and even is stated to have threatened to kill her.

The said story was narrated by her to her husband who got the Indrasen Seth vs State Of U.P. And Another on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/56189554/
1

entities.text: Indrasen Seth vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: FIR instituted.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant has stated that the FIR is delayed by about five days and there is no explanation of the said delay caused.

The present FIR is counterblast to Case Crime No.284 of 2022, which was instituted by the servant of the applicant against the husband of the victim herein and the trial is going on and the case was fixed for prosecution evidence.
Learned counsel has stated that just to coerce the applicant to get the said case compromised, the present FIR has been instituted.
The allegations of Section 376 I.P.C. have been added at the stage of statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. which has been done after legal consultation.
The applicant has no criminal history to his credit.
Learned counsel has further stated that the applicant was granted interim protection vide order dated 17.3.2023 and he has not misused it.
Several other submissions have been made on behalf of the applicant to demonstrate the falsity of the allegations made against him.
The circumstances which, as per counsel, led to the false implication of the applicant have also been touched upon at length.
The applicant has apprehension of his arrest.

Learned counsel has stated that the applicant undertakes that he has co-operated in the investigation and is ready to do so in trial also failing which the State can move appropriate application for cancellation of anticipatory bail.
6.
Per contra, learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the anticipatory bail application but unable to dispute the submissions raised by the learned counsel for the applicant.

7. On due consideration to the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and considering the nature of accusations and antecedents of the applicant, the applicant is liable to be enlarged on anticipatory bail in view of the judgment of Supreme Court in the case of "Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi), (2020) 5 SCC 1".

entities.text: Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi), (2020) 5 SCC 1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The future contingencies regarding the anticipatory bail being granted to applicant shall also be taken care of as per the aforesaid judgment of the Apex Court.
8. In view of the above, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed.

entities.text: Indrasen Seth vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: (iv). that in case charge-sheet is submitted the applicant shall not tamper with the evidence during the trial;
(v). that the applicant shall not pressurize/ intimidate the prosecution witness;

(vi). that the applicant shall appear before the trial court on each date fixed unless personal presence is exempted;
(vii). that in case of breach of any of the above conditions the court concerned shall have the liberty to cancel the bail.
9. It is made clear that observations made hereinabove are exclusively for deciding the instant anticipatory bail application and shall not affect the trial.

Order Date :- 19.9.2023/ Vikas [Krishan Pahal, J.]
